label: MiniMax H3 Max, 3D to video (fal): built for previs clips like the pill clip

price.source: fal pricing for minimax/h3-max/3d-to-video (billed in units; check the unit on fal before budgeting)

notes: The output length and aspect ratio follow the source video. There are no duration or ratio fields.

The prompt is a short 'scene intent' (2000 characters at most). The template prompts are 5000+ characters, so write a short one and pass it with --prompt-file. tools/seedance/lean_v3.py builds a short prompt from a scene file.
No audio references. Speaking shots need another provider.
